newsitem.title: USA: China buys 13,500 T Argentine soyoil - US exporters.
newsitem.headline: China buys 13,500 T Argentine soyoil - US exporters.

text.p: Two commercial firms purchased at least 13,500 tonnes of Argentine soyoil for shipment to China at $512.00 per tonne FOB, U.S. exporters said Thursday.
"They bought it, but it (the purchase) is certainly nothing out of the ordinary," said one U.S. exporter.
The purchase will be parceled out in three 4,500-tonne positions for shipment during May, June and July, exporters said.
Rumors had circulated on the trading floor that China purchased up to 30,000 tonnes of soyoil from South American and had purchased 10,000 tonnes of European vegetable oil.
The European purchase could not be confirmed, and some exporters said such as deal was unlikely because South American prices are currently more competitve.
One exporter characterized the recent Chinese oil purchase as a "trading position." He said that if soyoil prices moved higher, the firms that bought the soyoil, were likely to re-sell it.
CBOT traders said the China news buoyed soyoil prices. At 1021 CST, March soyoil was up 0.07 cent per pound at 24.07.
